name: issue a crafted management request formatted for cross-service verification
definition: Form an HTTP request to the object-store's management control path carrying the headers/content type the misconfigured endpoint expects so the service replies instead of refusing the request.
failure_mode: Wrong content type or an endpoint variant never returns a usable credential response.

name: keep a VM running in the background and expose its display/monitor via VNC
definition: Leave the emulator running and expose the guest display over VNC plus a web monitoring port.
failure_mode: the process exits and the disk activity stalls
